name: Cloak and Dagger
description: Vanishes onto a tile up to %cast_range% tiles away and ambushes anyone already standing there. For %duration% turns this unit stays hidden and untouchable, ambushing any enemy that steps onto the tile. Ambushes deal %dmg_penalty:pct%% less base damage, though Backstab contributes %backstab_bonus:pct%% more.
